answer: Agents deposit bonded stake and, under a Semaphore membership proof, evaluate an epoch polynomial whose committed coefficients bind each identity to an RLN rate limit. Each valid message carries a nullifier; duplicate use exposes two Shamir shares of the hidden secret, enabling reconstruction of the private key and immediate, verifiable collateral slashing. Sybil creation therefore costs stake, while wander, bridge, and cedar remain harmless labels.
